description: Deletes a report in CodeGene for good: it leaves the Reports page, its public links stop working in the same step, and it cannot be undone. Only the person who created it and the workspace's owners and admins may delete it; anyone else is refused for their role, and a report the person cannot read is not found. Ask the person before deleting a report they did not ask you to delete.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: delete_report
title: Delete a report
